v.s: Xavier fires a Mystic Bullet that deals 425( +150% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies it passes through.\nThe Bullet's flying distance increases each time it hits an enemy or the (Mystic Barrier) (up to 5 times).

Xavier conjures a (Mystic Barrier) that lasts 5s. Enemies that come into contact with the Barrier will take 125( +60% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) and be slowed by 50%, while allies will gain 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.2s.\nWhen hit by Xavier's other skills, the Barrier expands into a (Mystic Field) for 3s, dealing 300( +120% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

Xavier unleashes a beam of Mystic magic in the target direction, dealing 650( +150% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to all enemies along its path.\nOnce cast, he also directly enters the (Transcendence) state and resets the state's duration.

Xavier enhances his subsequent skills each time his skill hits an enemy hero. (Stage I:) Increases Movement Speed by 50% when subsequent skills hit, decaying over 1.2s. (Stage II:) Width of subsequent skills will be greatly increased. (Stage III:) Skill Cooldown reduced by 4s (12s for the Ultimate). At (Stage III), Xavier enters the (Transcendence) state.\n(Transcendence:) All of Xavier's skills are enhanced to (Stage III) state for 5s (this duration is extended by 1s each time Xavier's skill hits an enemy).
Unique Passive - Mana Spring: Regenerates 15% Max Mana every 10s.
Unique Passive - Scorch: Burn targets for 3s, dealing Magic Damage equal to 1.5% of the target's Max HP per second.
Unique Passive - Timestream: Hero kills or assists reduce the Ultimate's current cooldown by 30%.
Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).
Unique Passive - Spellbreaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Magic Penetration for each point of the enemy's Magic Defense, capped at 20%.
